flaws.description: User input is interpolated into a where clause that is executed dynamically via format(), which is SQL injection; parameters must be bound instead
The search_vector column has no GIN index, so every search sequentially scans and ranks tens of thousands of rows
Amenities are fetched with one query per listing in a loop, an N+1 pattern that alone blows the 300 ms budget
The function returns every matching row with no LIMIT and the API ships the full set to the client for client-side paging
keywords: limit|paginat|unbounded|page size|every matching|all matching|full result|entire result|whole result

flaws.description: The search route uses the service-role client, bypassing RLS; combined with the injectable where clause any draft or private listing data is exposed
A leading-wildcard ILIKE cannot use the lower(title) btree index; it needs pg_trgm or a prefix-only pattern
keywords: leading wildcard|%|trigram|pg_trgm|cannot use|can't use|won't use|will not use|not use|does not use|unable
